profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer / architect with extensive experience in building new technologies and products. I am creative, productive, practical, easy to work with, and have excellent design, communication and motivational skills. 

I view great software design as an art, requiring clear focus coupled with strong minimalism aesthetics, the ability to see the bigger picture than the immediate needs, insight on when to generalize and when to specialize, economy of representation, and finesse to power through massive changes smoothly when plans change.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Came to Google with the Metaweb acquisition. Designed and developed a distributed query language that is a core technology of Knowledge Graph.

positions.title: Sr. Engineer
positions.description: Redesigned the MQL query language used by Freebase. Rewriting in O'Caml provided orders of magnitude reduction in query latency and increase in throughput.

positions.title: Director of Platform Technology, Architect
positions.description: Managed telephony platform group, systems engineering group, and QA. Later as architect worked to develop and launch Scriptable CallManager platform.

positions.title: Architect and co-founder
positions.description: Helped design Kontiki's grid delivery technology. Kontiki was sold to Verisign in 2006.

positions.title: Senior Principal Engineer
positions.description: Made a browser. Responsible to initial integration of Java into Netscape 2 browser. Designed and developed Java JNI, NSPR, mail/news, new networking stack for Mozilla browser, and 3rd party Java integration APIs.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Created Personal TeleScript platform for PCs.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Designed and implemented AppleScript language. AppleScript is still in use on Macintosh systems today!

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Artifical intelligence research
Programming language and type theory/research

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Artificial Intelligence research / knowledge representation / inference
